title: Landing Gear — Main Gear Sliding Tube — Introduction of the HVOF Coated Tube at Overhaul

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Main Gear — Main Gear Leg Assembly

abstract: Instruction to overhaul shops to replace the chromium electroplated running surface of the main gear sliding tube by a sprayed tungsten carbide coating, doubling the sliding tube overhaul interval.

sections.planning_reason: Hard chrome plating of landing gear running surfaces relies on hexavalent chromium, whose industrial authorisation is being withdrawn. Two of the four approved overhaul shops have given notice that they will stop offering the process, which would leave the fleet dependent on a single plant for a component with a twelve-year overhaul cycle. The sprayed coating also resists scoring roughly three times better, so the sliding tube overhaul interval doubles once it is applied.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin instructs the overhaul shop to strip the chromium plating from the sliding tube, apply a high velocity oxygen fuel sprayed tungsten carbide cobalt chromium coating, and grind and superfinish it to the same diameter and surface roughness as the plated surface so that no seal change is required. The torque link clamp is renewed because the coating build-up alters the clearance, and the obsolete sensor kit is deleted from the leg assembly.
sections.accomplishment_summary: This bulletin is embodied at leg overhaul, not on the aircraft. At the shop, strip and inspect the sliding tube and confirm that the base metal is within limits after plating removal. Mask the non-coated areas and spray the tungsten carbide coating to the thickness given in the process sheet. Grind and superfinish to the drawing diameter and verify the surface roughness. Renew the torque link clamp D3210114090552 and retain the vendor clamp CAD561133-34. Delete the obsolete sensor kit D3210110015901 from the assembly and update the leg build record. Re-assemble the leg, do the proof pressure test and the retraction test on the rig. At aircraft level the activity is limited to a leg change from zones 721, 732 and 734, followed by a retraction test and a brake and steering functional check. Record the embodiment against the leg serial number and against the aircraft.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all ZEPHYR-22 family aircraft. Because the change is embodied at leg overhaul, the effectivity is expressed against the leg rather than against a delivery block, and a single aircraft may fly with one coated and one plated leg until its second overhaul.
sections.material_note: No aircraft kit. The coating is applied as a shop process against the specification given in the bulletin. Revision 02 added the superfinishing requirement after two shops delivered legs with a roughness that shortened seal life.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled main landing gear overhaul.

revision_history.reason: Superfinishing requirement added after two shops delivered legs with a roughness that shortened seal life
